eventDescription:
In collaboration with the Vidhaigal Volunteer Organization, the Vallakottai Murugan Temple administration, and the Triveni Academy National Green Corps students, a tree-planting ceremony was successfully conducted today on one acre of land belonging to the Vallakottai Murugan Temple, during which 108 saplings were planted.
Students, nature enthusiasts, and members of the public participated with great enthusiasm, planting saplings and demonstrating their commitment to protecting the environment.
